question: Who was awarded the 2025 Abel Prize?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Masaki Kashiwara**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Japanese mathematician Masaki Kashiwara awarded the Abel Prize 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Recipient of the 2025 Abel Prize**: Masaki Kashiwara, a Japanese mathematician.

 
 
• 
 
**Field of Contribution**:

 
 
• 
 
Algebraic analysis

 
 
• 
 
Representation theory

 
 
• 
 
Development of D-modules

 
 
• 
 
Discovery of crystal bases.

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**About the Abel Prize**:

 
 
• 
 
Named after Niels Henrik Abel, a legendary Norwegian mathematician.

 
 
• 
 
Established by the Norwegian Parliament in 2002 to commemorate Abel's 200th birth anniversary.

 
 
• 
 
First awarded in 2003.

 
 
• 
 
Often regarded as the Nobel Prize equivalent in mathematics.

 
 
• 
 
Awarded by a committee in consultation with the International Mathematical Union (IMU) and the European Mathematical Society (EMS).

 
 
• 
 
Includes a cash award and a glass plaque designed by Norwegian artist Henrik Haugan.
